user.title: Set up Smart Irrigation
user.description: Smart Irrigation is set up afterwards in its own panel in the sidebar: its setup assistant creates a sensor group and a first zone with you, and the weather service is chosen there too.

create_entry.default: Smart Irrigation is installed. Open **Smart Irrigation** in the sidebar: the [setup assistant](/smart_irrigation/setup) creates your first zone with you.

credit_watering.name: Credit watering
credit_watering.description: Credit a zone's water balance with the water a run actually delivered, instead of setting it to 0.

seconds.name: Seconds
seconds.description: How long the zone ran, in seconds. Empty: the zone's duration.

run_program.name: Run program
run_program.description: Run a program of the full controller now, or as soon as it is its turn when another one is running. The program waters its zones with the durations Smart Irrigation calculated, unless its steps say otherwise.

program_id.name: Program
program_id.description: The id of the program, as shown in its settings.

seconds.name: Seconds
seconds.description: A total duration for the whole program, shared between its steps in proportion to their planned durations. Left empty, the planned durations.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: What to do when something is already watering. Queue takes the turn behind it; replace stops it cleanly first.

stop_program.name: Stop program
stop_program.description: Stop one program. If it is running, its open zones are closed the normal way and credited for what they delivered; if it is waiting for its turn, it is taken out of the queue. An unknown program does nothing. The main program is stopped with stop_watering.

set_program_enabled.name: Enable or disable a program
set_program_enabled.description: Switch a program of the full controller on or off, as the switch in its settings does.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: On to enable it, off to disable it.

set_step_enabled.name: Enable or disable a step
set_step_enabled.description: Switch one step of a program on or off.

step_id.name: Step
step_id.description: The id of the step, as shown in the program.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: On to enable it, off to disable it.

set_schedule_enabled.name: Enable or disable a schedule
set_schedule_enabled.description: Switch one schedule of a program on or off. The schedules are armed again at once.

schedule_id.name: Schedule
schedule_id.description: The id of the schedule, as shown in the program.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: On to enable it, off to disable it.

stop_watering.name: Stop watering
stop_watering.description: Stop the watering now. Every valve Smart Irrigation opened is closed, each zone is credited for the water it delivered, and the programs and the zones still waiting are ended. With zones chosen, only those are stopped.

pause_watering.name: Pause watering
pause_watering.description: Close the open valves and hold the watering, the zones still waiting included. What was delivered is credited, and after the resume the rest of the pass is watered. A pause that is not lifted ends by itself.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: The longest the pause lasts before it lifts itself.

resume_watering.name: Resume watering
resume_watering.description: Go on with a paused watering from where it stopped.

next_step.name: Next step
next_step.description: End the zones of the step a program is on and go on to the next step.

suspend.name: Suspend
suspend.description: Keep a zone or a program from watering until a moment. With no duration and no date, or zero hours, the suspension is lifted.

program_id.name: Program
program_id.description: The id of a program to suspend.

hours.name: Hours
hours.description: How long to suspend for. Zero lifts it.

adjust_program.name: Adjust a program
adjust_program.description: Make a program of the full controller water longer or shorter, for a while. The adjustment replaces the previous one (it never adds up), applies to the runs that start after it is set, and ends after the hours given.

program_id.name: Program
program_id.description: The id of the program to adjust.

percent.name: Percent
percent.description: Multiplies the water of each step (120 waters 20 % longer).

seconds.name: Seconds
seconds.description: Seconds of water added to each step (negative to take off).

hours.name: Hours
hours.description: How long the adjustment lasts. Left empty, until it is reset.

reset.name: Reset
reset.description: Remove the adjustment of this program.

water_zone.name: Water a zone
water_zone.description: Water a zone now, or as soon as it is its turn when something is watering. Without a duration, the zone waters for the duration Smart Irrigation calculated.

zone_id.name: Zone id
zone_id.description: The id of the zone, instead of its entity.

seconds.name: Seconds
seconds.description: Seconds of water. Left empty, the calculated duration.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: What to do when something is already watering. Queue takes the turn behind it; replace stops it cleanly first.

use_measured_throughput.name: Use the measured throughput
use_measured_throughput.description: Set a zone's throughput to the flow its meter measured over its runs. The measurement is only ever advice; this is how to accept it.

zone_id.name: Zone id

dry_zone_not_watered.title: Zone {zone} is dry and nothing will water it
dry_zone_not_watered.description:
The water balance of zone **{zone}** has been dry for {days} days, and every program that includes it is disabled, suspended or has no enabled schedule.

Turn a program that waters this zone back on, enable one of its schedules, or lift its suspension. The notice clears by itself once the zone is watered or a program covers it again.

weather_silent.title: Sensor group {mapping}: a weather sensor stopped reporting
weather_silent.description:
Nothing has been received for over {hours} hours from: **{sensors}**. The last report was on {since}.

A reading that old is left out of the calculation, so the zones of this sensor group are calculated on what remains, or not at all.

Check the sensor's battery, its connection and its entity in Home Assistant. The notice clears by itself as soon as it reports again.

missing_input.title: Zone {zone}: nothing could be calculated
missing_input.description:
The evapotranspiration of zone **{zone}** could not be calculated because the weather data had no value for: **{missing}**.

Until it does, the zone's deficit does not move and it is not watered, which looks exactly like a zone with no need.

Check that the sensors mapped to those fields are available, or that the weather service still sends them. The issue clears at the next calculation that can be done.

undersized_zone.title: Zone {zone}: one run cannot water what it loses
undersized_zone.description:
The longest run of zone **{zone}** delivers about **{capacity} mm**, but the zone loses about **{need} mm** between two waterings ({days} day(s)). Its deficit will keep growing however long the weather stays as it is.

The cap is the zone's maximum duration. Raise it, give the zone more emitters or a higher throughput, or lower the days between irrigation. If the cap is on purpose, you can ignore this.

throughput_mismatch.title: Zone {zone}: measured flow does not match the configured throughput
throughput_mismatch.description:
Over the last {samples} runs, the flow meter on zone **{zone}** measured about **{measured}** where the zone is configured for **{configured}** - {percentage}% off.

Every irrigation duration is derived from the configured throughput, so they are all off by roughly the same amount.

If the measurement looks right, set the zone's throughput to it. If it does not, check that the meter only counts this zone, and that mains pressure is what you expect. Smart Irrigation never changes the value for you.

zone_not_calculated_no_readings.title: Zone {zone} cannot be calculated: no weather readings
zone_not_calculated_no_readings.description:
Zone **{zone}** was not calculated: its sensor group has no readings to calculate from. Until it has, the zone's deficit does not move and it is not watered.

Check that the sensor group has sources and that they report, update the weather data, then calculate the zone. The notice clears by itself at the next calculation that succeeds.

zone_not_calculated_no_engine.title: Zone {zone} cannot be calculated: no module
zone_not_calculated_no_engine.description:
Zone **{zone}** has no module, so it is not calculated and not watered.

Choose how it is calculated on its card in the Zones tab. The notice clears by itself at the next calculation that succeeds.

zone_not_calculated_nothing_from_engine.title: Zone {zone} cannot be calculated: no evapotranspiration
zone_not_calculated_nothing_from_engine.description:
Zone **{zone}** takes its evapotranspiration from a sensor or a weather service, and its sensor group had none to give. Until it has, the zone is not watered.

Check the sensor that provides the evapotranspiration, or the weather service. The notice clears by itself at the next calculation that succeeds.

zone_not_calculated_forecast_without_ser.title: Zone {zone} cannot be calculated: a forecast without a weather service
zone_not_calculated_forecast_without_ser.description:
The module of zone **{zone}** looks days ahead, which needs a weather service, and none is set up. The zone is not watered until it can be calculated.

Set up a weather service, or set the module's forecast days to 0. The notice clears by itself at the next calculation that succeeds.

zone_not_calculated_error.title: Zone {zone} cannot be calculated: an error
zone_not_calculated_error.description:
The calculation of zone **{zone}** failed: {detail}

The zone is not watered until it can be calculated. If it keeps failing, please open an issue with this message and the diagnostics file. The notice clears by itself at the next calculation that succeeds.

zone_not_calculated_no_sensor_group.title: Zone {zone} cannot be calculated: no sensor group
zone_not_calculated_no_sensor_group.description:
Zone **{zone}** has no sensor group, so there is nothing to calculate it from and it is not watered.

Choose its sensor group on its card in the Zones tab, then calculate the zone. The notice clears by itself at the next calculation that succeeds.

deprecated_action.title: The action {action} is going away
deprecated_action.description:
An automation, a script or a dashboard called **{action}**. It still works, but it will be removed from version {version} on, in winter, outside the watering season.

Use **{replacement}** instead: it does the same, and for all zones when no zone is picked. This notice comes back with each call to the old name, until none is left.

deprecated_recurring_schedule.title: Recurring schedules are going away: {action}
deprecated_recurring_schedule.description:
An automation, a script or a dashboard called **{action}**. Recurring schedules still work, but they will be removed from version {version} on, in winter, outside the watering season.

The programs' schedules do the same and are in the panel: set them up under **Watering**, then remove the recurring schedules and the calls to {action}.
